Info

Coordinates compilation of Cartesian linear, joint, approach, retract, and arc motion DSL instructions.

class scarajectory.core.service.dsl.compiler.motion.motion_command_compiler.MotionCommandCompiler(*, cartesian_compiler: IPrimitiveCompiler, vertical_compiler: IPrimitiveCompiler, arc_compiler: IPrimitiveCompiler)[source]¶

Bases: object

Sub-compiler coordinator handling motion instructions (MOVE_L, MOVE_J, APPROACH, RETRACT, ARC_CW, ARC_CCW). Delegates compilation directly to specialized sub-compilers without private methods.

It defines:

attributes:
_SUPPORTED - Frozenset of handled CommandType instances.
_cartesian_compiler - Sub-compiler for Cartesian linear and joint moves.
_vertical_compiler - Sub-compiler for approach and retract moves.
_arc_compiler - Sub-compiler for circular arc moves.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes motion compiler with injected sub-compilers.
can_compile - Checks if command is a motion instruction.
compile - Delegates compilation to matching sub-compiler.
_SUPPORTED: frozenset[CommandType] = frozenset({CommandType.APPROACH, CommandType.ARC_CCW, CommandType.ARC_CW, CommandType.MOVE_J, CommandType.MOVE_L, CommandType.RETRACT})¶
_arc_compiler: IPrimitiveCompiler¶
_cartesian_compiler: IPrimitiveCompiler¶
_vertical_compiler: IPrimitiveCompiler¶
can_compile(*, instruction: Instruction) → bool[source]¶

Determines whether this coordinator handles the specified instruction.

Parameters:

instruction – Primitive AST instruction node.

Returns:

True if handled, False otherwise.

Exceptions:

None.

compile(*, instruction: Instruction, context: ScaraCompilerContext, waypoints: list[Waypoint]) → None[source]¶

Processes motion instructions by delegating to the appropriate sub-compiler.

Parameters:

  • instruction – Primitive AST instruction node.

  • context – Mutable compiler execution context.

  • waypoints – Accumulator list of compiled Waypoint instances.

Exceptions:

None.
